def: to drag off roughly; by implication, to bring up the cud (i.e. ruminate); by analogy, to saw

occurrences.text: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.

All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
Behold, the whirlwind of the Lord goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
